The forward made his first team and MLS debut in his second call-up last season, coming off the bench as a second half substitute in the away match at Columbus Crew on June 14. Selemani, 18,Â signed his first professional contract with WFC2 last year in June . After recovering from a right foot fracture suffered late in preseason, he returned to action with the second team on Wednesday, playing 28 minutes against Austin FC II. Last season, Selemani started 17 of his 24 appearances, recording one goal and adding two assists.Â Prior to signing his contract, the native of Edmonton, Alberta spent time playing with WFC2 as an amateur player during the 2024 and 2025 MLS NEXT Pro seasons. The forward originally joined the Whitecaps FC BMO Academy in August 2022 after previously playing with BTB Soccer Academy. In addition, Selemani has competed with Whitecaps FC at the BC Premier League and MLS NEXT levels. At the international level, Selemani has represented Canada at the U-15 and U-17 age groups. The forward was part of Canadaâs roster at the Concacaf U-17 Championship last year, where he started two of his three appearances and scored once en route to helping Canada to a perfect 4W-0L-0D record to secure qualification to the 2025 FIFA U-17 World Cup.
